other_conditions: Applicant or his/her husband/wife/father must be a registered construction worker with updated contribution.
Dependent wife or unmarried daughter have no age limit.
Dependent son must be 21 years or younger.
Only registered workers are eligible for wage reimbursement; dependents are not.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of training fees, materials, and the minimum unskilled wage for the registered worker attending training.
